			MasterDbInstanceId:       pulumi.Any(pgsqlId),
			Name:                     pulumi.String("tf_test_ro_sg"),
			ProjectId:                pulumi.Int(0),
			SubnetId:                 pulumi.Any(subnetId),
			VpcId:                    pulumi.Any(vpcId),
			ReplayLagEliminate:       pulumi.Int(1),
			ReplayLatencyEliminate:   pulumi.Int(1),
			MaxReplayLag:             pulumi.Int(100),
			MaxReplayLatency:         pulumi.Int(512),
			MinDelayEliminateReserve: pulumi.Int(1),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = postgresql.NewSecurityGroupConfig(ctx, "security_group_config", &postgresql.SecurityGroupConfigArgs{
			SecurityGroupIdSets: pulumi.StringArray{
				sgId,
				sgId2,
			},
			ReadOnlyGroupId: group.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
